name: @pipeworx/mcp-wynncraft

tools.name: player
tools.description: Fetch a Wynncraft player's stats by UUID or username: playtime, XP, guild, ranking, veteran status, and per-class totals.

tools.name: guild
tools.description: Fetch Wynncraft guild details by name or prefix (set by='prefix' to look up by tag); returns member list, level, XP, territories, and seasonal rating.

tools.name: leaderboard
tools.description: Fetch a Wynncraft leaderboard by type; returns ranked entries up to resultLimit. `type` must be one of the API's leaderboard ids — e.g. 'combatGlobalLevel', 'guildLevel', 'warsCompletion', 'playerContent' — NOT a generic word like 'overall' or 'level', which the API rejects with InvalidLeaderboardType.

type.description: Leaderboard id, e.g. combatGlobalLevel, guildLevel, warsCompletion, playerContent

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-wynncraft forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the wynncraft pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
